signal.title: orders-api error rate 5.4% / 5xx surge (SLO burn 14.4x) after release 2026.07.10-r3 in eu-west-1
signal.body: Error rate SLO burn started 4 minutes after release 2026.07.10-r3 reached 100% of pods. HTTP 503/500 ratio climbed from 0.4% to 5.4% (alert threshold 2% for 10m). Upstream resets concentrate on POST /v1/orders and POST /v1/orders/{id}/confirm; charging-gateway calls exceed the 2500ms deadline on retry. Error budget burn 14.4x on the 1h window. Rollback candidate: this release enabled strict idempotency-key validation on the order-write path. Affected regions: eu-west-1 (primary), eu-central-1 (partial via failback traffic).

signal.title: postgres-primary connection pool exhausted — pgbouncer cl_waiting=312, deadlocks on tenant shard tnt-7f3 during billing close
signal.body: pgbouncer pool 'main' saturated: cl_active=200 cl_waiting=312 (pool_size=200, reserve=0, maxwait 47s). pg_stat_activity shows 68 backends idle-in-transaction >30s with wait_event Lock:transactionid concentrated on relation invoice_line_items (tenant shard tnt-7f3, tenant acme-industrial). 14 deadlocks in the last 10 minutes (SQLSTATE 40P01) between concurrent invoice reconciliation batches. New connections rejected with FATAL 53300 too many connections; the order-write path is timing out end to end. WAL and streaming replication remain healthy (0 bytes lag). Suspected trigger: tenant bulk import running alongside the end-of-day billing close job.

signal.title: shop-web checkout p95 latency 8.4s — enterprise tenants reporting hangs (NRT-4412, NRT-4415)
signal.body: Support escalation rolled up from #tenant-success: 9 enterprise tenants (incl. NRT-4412 Globex, NRT-4415 Initech) report checkout hanging 8-12s since ~11:40Z. Synthetic checks confirm checkout p95 latency of 8.4s against a 1.2s baseline; TTFB dominates — the browser waterfall shows /checkout/session blocking 7.9s server-side. Static assets and login are unaffected and there is no error spike; requests eventually succeed. CSM has flagged contractual SLA breach risk (2s p95) for tier-1 tenants if this persists past 13:00Z.

signal.title: redis-cache session tier p99 GET 42ms — cross-domain impact on checkout session reads
signal.body: Cross-domain impact: redis-cache cluster (session tier) p99 GET latency at 42ms vs 2ms baseline. evicted_keys running at 3.1k/s under allkeys-lru after connected_clients doubled to 9,800; keyspace hit ratio dropped 99.4% -> 91.2%, pushing session reads to the persistence layer and degrading checkout session lookups on orders-api (p95 +2.1s). used_memory 28.4GB of 30GB maxmemory. No cluster topology changes in the window; suspected hot-key pattern from the new session-prefetch rollout.

signal.title: upf-session-gw GTP-U packet drops 2.3% on N3 interface during PFCP signaling surge (site mad-edge-02)
signal.body: 5G core edge site mad-edge-02 reporting sustained GTP-U tunnel packet drops (2.3%, baseline 0.01%) on the N3 reference point. PFCP session-establishment rate is 4.1x baseline following an AMF re-registration storm in the adjacent tracking area; the UPF session table is at 87% capacity and GTP-U echo responses are intermittently late. Subscriber impact: intermittent uplink stalls for ~18k PDU sessions. The component was onboarded last sprint by the packet-core team and has no linked runbook.
